routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's labels (and title/content/color/reminder); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive or unarchive a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash; returns 200 with the removed count

notes: REQ-2.7.6.2 (return from a label-filtered view to the full notes list) is a follow-up to the REQ-2.7.6.1 label filter built on REQ-2.7.1. The sidebar (opened via the 'Main menu' button) contains the 'Notes' nav item (button, exact accessible name 'Notes' from the REQ-1.1 spec, with the 🗒️ icon aria-hidden so the accessible name is exactly 'Notes'). Scenario: with a label filter active (e.g. clicking 'Work' hides 'Movie list' because it carries no 'Work' label), clicking 'Notes' in the sidebar must clear the filter and show all notes. Fix: the .nav-item click handler in frontend/src/app.js now resets state.labelFilter to null when the clicked item's data-view is 'notes' (and re-renders the sidebar label buttons so no filter stays highlighted). The label filter itself (REQ-2.7.6.1) is untouched: clicking a label button still sets state.labelFilter and visibleInView() still hides notes without the label, so filtering still works and both acceptance tests pass. Fixtures: 'Design review' (labels ['Work']) and 'Movie list' (labels []) are seeded in backend/data/db.json. No backend or route changes are required: the filter is pure per-page-load client state (state.labelFilter), so parallel test files sharing one server never observe each other's filters.
